description: List a company's SEC filings, newest first: form, filing date, report date, acceptance time, accession number, 8-K item codes, size, XBRL flags, primary document URL and filing index URL. Filter by form types (e.g. 10-K,10-Q,8-K; amendments like 10-K/A included unless include_amendments=false) and date range. Up to 50 results; searches the full EDGAR submission history (recent 1,000 filings plus up to 2 older pages). Data: SEC EDGAR public APIs (sec.gov, data.sec.gov), US public domain, no API key. Not-found and upstream errors are not charged. Costs $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

company.description: Ticker (AAPL, BRK.B), CIK (320193 or 0000320193) or company name

forms.description: Form types to include, comma list or array (default all)

include_amendments.description: Also match /A amendments of the given forms (default true)

name: recent_filings
